name: Tenstorrent Wormhole N300, vLLM+TT-Metal: Llama-3.1-8B single-stream decode tok/s
methodology: THIRD-PARTY measured (community video teardown, summarized in gist). vLLM + TT-Metal stack on a single N300 (dual-chip Wormhole, 24GB). Llama-3.1-8B decode warmed up from ~3.6 tok/s to a stabilized ~30 tok/s single stream. Prompt processing reported ~3700-4000 tok/s. 8 concurrent requests reached ~164 tok/s aggregate. Vendor-claimed reference for the same model is ~44 tok/s (different quantization).
notes: Community measurement, lower confidence (video teardown via summary gist, not a controlled scoreboard). Stabilized single-stream value used; the 3.6 tok/s figure is warm-up. Vendor claims 44 tok/s at a different quant - status kept verified but confidence low. Power draw was NOT instrumented in the source (an earlier ~70 W figure was an estimate, removed rather than reported without a clock-lock disclosure).
